name: support-triage
description: Route a support ticket, rate its urgency, and decide whether money back is being asked for. Mirrors the published customer-service workflow, with multi-intent, tone-vs-severity and negated-refund cases added.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket? Choose the team that owns the main thing the customer needs done.

criteria.technical: Bugs, outages, API errors, product behaviour, feature requests
criteria.account: Sign-in, passwords, two-factor, permissions, account deletion
criteria.shipping: Physical delivery, tracking, damaged or missing parcels

urgency.instructions: How urgent is this ticket, judged by the impact on the customer right now, not by how loudly it is written?
criteria: low: a question or a nice-to-have; nothing is blocked
medium: something is wrong and the customer is inconvenienced but still working
high: the customer is blocked, losing money, or at security risk right now

refund.instructions: Is the customer asking for money back in this message?

criteria.true: They ask for a refund, reversal, chargeback or their money back, now
criteria.false: No such ask, or they mention refunds only in passing, hypothetically, or to decline one

cases.state: I was charged twice for the same order last Tuesday. Can someone look into it?
My card was declined but the money left my account anyway.
Where can I download last quarter's invoices for my accountant?
Please cancel my subscription before the next renewal on the 3rd.
You billed me $499 instead of $49. This is the third month in a row.
Do you offer annual plans, and is there a discount?
The export button does nothing in Safari. Works in Chrome.
Our production webhooks have been failing with 500s since the deploy this morning. Customers are affected.
Is there a dark mode?
API returns 401 with a key I generated ten minutes ago.
The CSV import silently drops rows with commas inside quotes.
Feature request: let me sort the dashboard by last edited.
I cannot log in. Password reset emails never arrive.
Please add my colleague sam@acme.com as an admin.
I want to delete my account and everything in it under GDPR.
Two-factor is locked to an old phone I no longer have.
How do I change the email address on my profile?
Someone else logged into my account from another country last night.
My package says delivered but nothing arrived.
cases.notes: warrants a refund, does not ask for one

cases.state: Can I change the delivery address on order B-2291? It has not shipped yet.
How long does standard delivery take to Portugal?
The box arrived crushed and the screen is cracked.
Tracking has not updated in six days.
Do you ship to PO boxes?
I cannot log in, and while you are at it I want last month refunded.
cases.notes: multi-intent: login blocks use, refund is secondary

cases.state: The app crashes on upload and I have been charged for a plan I never used.
My order is late and the discount code did not apply.
cases.notes: multi-intent; a pricing complaint is not a refund request

cases.state: Please close my account and refund the unused portion of the year.

No rush at all, but production has been down for two hours.
THIS IS ABSOLUTELY UNACCEPTABLE. The logo is the wrong shade of blue.

I read your refund policy and it seems fair. No action needed.
Do not refund me — I want the item replaced instead.
A friend told me you refunded her. Is that normal?
If this happens again I will ask for my money back.
cases.notes: conditional future refund, not a request now

cases.state: I would like my money back for the duplicate charge.
Please reverse the payment from yesterday.
Charge me back for the month the service was down.
There are three charges from a country I have never visited.
cases.notes: fraud flavour; reporting charges is not asking for a reversal
